Definition: to light upon (chiefly by accident); causatively, to bring about; specifically, to impose timbers (for roof or floor)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to encounter, meet, befall, happen, come to meet; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to encounter, meet; 1a2) to befall; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to encounter, meet (without pre-arrangement); 1b2) to chance to be present; 1b3) to come to meet; 1c) (Hiphil) to cause to meet, appoint; 2) to build with beams; 2a) (Piel) to lay the beams of, furnish with beams
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
